meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 启用后,Claude会通过Microsoft Graph帮您创建和管理AI代理在微软Entra里的身份:创建代理身份蓝图、蓝图主体和各实例的独立代理身份,并配置OAuth2.0令牌交换与权限授权。
howto.when: 当您提出要创建Agent Identity Blueprint、配置代理的fmi_path/OBO令牌交换、管理跨租户Agent Identities等Agent ID需求时触发;标准Entra应用注册不适用。

say.text: 创建一个代理身份蓝图,名为“订单代理”。
say.note: Claude会生成创建请求,并返回新蓝图ID。

say.text: 为“订单代理”蓝图创建蓝图主体。
say.note: 这一步必须有,否则后续会报400错误。
Claude会调用应用角色分配接口完成授权。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to build and manage AI-agent identities in Microsoft Entra via Microsoft Graph: create agent identity blueprints, blueprint principals, per-instance agent identities, and configure OAuth2.0 token exchange and permission grants.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create an Agent Identity Blueprint, configure agent fmi_path/OBO token exchange, manage cross-tenant Agent Identities, or similar Agent ID tasks. Not for standard Entra app registration.

say_en.text: Create an agent identity blueprint named Order Agent.
say_en.note: Claude returns the new Blueprint ID.

say_en.text: Create the blueprint principal for the Order Agent blueprint.
say_en.note: This is mandatory to avoid 400 errors later.

say_en.text: Grant agent-1 the User.Read.All application permission.
say_en.note: Claude uses the app role assignment endpoint.
